mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment (target_type, target_id, user_id, reply_to_id, parent_id, content, like_count, upvote_list, status, create_time) VALUES (#{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{userId}, #{replyToId}, #{parentId}, #{content}, #{likeCount}0, #{upvoteList}, #{status}1, #{createTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE comment SET status = 0 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM comment WHERE id IN #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT , u.user_name AS user_name, u.user_avatar AS user_avatar, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment ch WHERE ch.parent_id = c.id AND ch.status = 1) AS child_count FROM comment c LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = c.user_id WHERE c.status = 1 AND c.parent_id IS NULL AND c.target_type = #{targetType} AND c.target_id = #{targetId} ORDER BY c.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT , u.user_name AS user_name, u.user_avatar AS user_avatar, rt.user_name AS reply_to_name FROM comment c LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = c.user_id LEFT JOIN user rt ON rt.id = c.reply_to_id WHERE c.status = 1 AND c.parent_id = #{parentId} ORDER BY c.create_time ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment c WHERE c.status = 1 AND c.parent_id = #{parentId}

SELECT , u.user_name AS user_name, u.user_avatar AS user_avatar, rt.user_name AS reply_to_name FROM comment c LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = c.user_id LEFT JOIN user rt ON rt.id = c.reply_to_id WHERE c.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE comment SET like_count = like_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE comment SET like_count = GREATEST(like_count - 1, 0) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE comment SET upvote_list = #{upvoteList} WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment c WHERE c.status = 1 AND c.user_id = #{userId}
